info.title: fieldtrial
info.summary: Run robot-policy evaluation studies: schedule, record, analyze.

schema.title: Response Studies Api V1 Studies Get

get.description: Progress of a study. No per-arm results while blinded.
The next slot to run, or null when every slot is done or running.

schema.title: Response Next Trial Api V1 Studies  Slug  Next Get

get.description: Interim-look status, or null when the study has no group-sequential rule.

schema.title: Response Interim Api V1 Studies  Slug  Interim Get

post.description: Run the interim look that is due. A stop cancels the remaining trials.
Start a session and return its console state.

get.description: A session's running trial, next slot and progress.

post.description: End a session (a running trial must be finished first).

schema.title: Response Trials Api V1 Studies  Slug  Trials Get

post.description: Start a trial for a pending slot (and its arm, when a runner runs the policy).

patch.description: Correct a completed trial's label (logged with old and new values).

post.description: Stop the clock; the duration ends here even if labelling takes longer.
Record the outcome of a running trial.
Void a trial and reschedule its slot.
Undo the outcome of a session's latest trial, within 10 s; it is running again.
Attach a clip or photo to a trial; it is stored under the study's media/ folder.

get.description:
Server-Sent Events: one ``changed`` event per new event-log row.

Starts after ``Last-Event-ID`` (or ``after``), or at the newest event. With
``once=true`` the stream sends what is new and closes, which suits simple polling.

CompleteIn.title: CompleteIn
CompleteIn.description:
The outcome of a running trial.

``stage`` is the furthest stage reached: a stage id, or ``None`` for no stage. Success
follows from reaching the study's success stage.

ConsoleOut.title: ConsoleOut
ConsoleOut.description: What a runtime or console needs for one session: the running trial or the next slot.

EditIn.title: EditIn
EditIn.description: Correct a completed trial's label. ``reason`` and ``actor`` are logged.

InterimOut.title: InterimOut
InterimOut.description: The outcome of an interim look: ``continue`` or ``stop``, nothing else.

InterimStatusOut.title: InterimStatusOut
InterimStatusOut.description: Interim looks of a group-sequential study. Counts only, nothing per arm.

InvalidateIn.title: InvalidateIn
InvalidateIn.description: Void a trial (robot fault, setup error) and reschedule it.

MediaOut.title: MediaOut
MediaOut.description: Where an attached file was stored, relative to the study folder.

SessionIn.title: SessionIn
SessionIn.description: Start a session: one operator on one rig.

SlotOut.title: SlotOut
SlotOut.description: A scheduled trial. ``arm``, ``policy`` and ``serving`` are hidden while blinded.

StartIn.title: StartIn
StartIn.description: Start a trial for a slot (normally ``up_next``).

StatusOut.title: StatusOut
StatusOut.description: Progress of a locked study. ``per_arm`` is ``None`` while blinded.

StopIn.title: StopIn
StopIn.description: Stop the clock on a running trial (it is labelled afterwards).

StudyOut.title: StudyOut
StudyOut.description: A study under the served folder.

TrialOut.title: TrialOut
TrialOut.description: A trial and its concurrency version (send it back as ``expected_version``).

UndoIn.title: UndoIn
UndoIn.description: Undo the latest trial of a session (within 10 s).
